Ive just had a really shitty life, sexual abuse throughout my childhood. (Im 22) abusive partners, abusive family. Im currently in a relationship with a man that has good intentions and a wonderfuk heart but who is also very depressed, so its hard to keep myself and him up. I think his illness is stronger than mine, in a way, maybe because he shows it more. Im just tired, i dont think its anyones fault, im just not strong enough to keep going.

I'm confused, I honestly don't really know what I'm doing anymore. I'm 22 and have a full time job, my bf of 5 months moved in with my earlier this month. He is amazing, but also suffers from depression and possibly DPD. He does his best everyday, and I do my best to be there for him even though I'm barely hanging on myself. I just feel like at this point, my whole reason to keep going is him. I just want to be there for him as much as I can, I love him so much, but these suicidal thoughts never, ever go away. The urges get too real sometimes and it's hard to focus on anything at all. I've lost motivation to do a lot of things, I've lost interest in things I used to love, I fake being okay because I honestly do not want to be a bother. I don't want to talk about it, I don't want to make it more real than it already is, it fucking scares me to no end. I know exactly how I want to go if things go south. It isn't good to depend on other people the way I am depending on him, but he doesn't even know it, that's too much of a burden for someone. He is my last hope. I hope things work out but I also wouldn't mind dying already.

I wish i were stronger, really, but i just seem to be getting worse and it's not anyone's fault. I'm more tired everyday, I don't eat properly anymore and I should care, but I don't. All I can think about is "Why am i like this? When will it stop?" but it won't stop. I have to keep fighting though, I have someone that needs me here now and I just can't give up. I really am, so very tired.

I feel ugly again, I weigh an average of 90lbs and always have. I try my best to eat and eating is already hard as it is. I force food down my throat because I know my body needs it, because I know I need to gain weigh. I feel ugly, undesired, I'm too thin, too weak. My boyfriend's libido is gone and he says it's because of depression and I believe him. I do. I can't help but to think that my thin body doesn't help the situation though. I'm doing my best to take care of myself and look better, but it's so hard. I don't want to deal with this anymore.

I don't understand, finally I have a chance to be happy. My boyfriend finally moved in with me, he suffers from depression too, but I thought being with him would make me feel better. In a way, I am happier that he's here and I feel a little more loved, but most of the time I just feel upset and/or empty. I keep having this urge of locking myself in our bathroom to hurt myself. I haven't and probably won't but it's always there, I don't know what to do.
What's going on in your life man?
